_doc: Mentions (@): one utterance calling back to another. Lighter than graph.json replies: utterance-to-utterance (entry ids, not works), and allowed to be an echo, allusion or shared formula with no claim of direct influence. kind: callback | echo | allusion | formula | quotes. basis: explicit | scholarly | editorial. note: <= 25 words on what is echoed.

mentions.note: Wisdom unlocks the word-hoard in the same words Beowulf uses: a stock Old English speech formula, not proof that the translator knew Beowulf.
